title: Beyond attention: performance pressure shifts information-processing complexity
title_zh: 超越注意力：绩效压力如何改变信息处理复杂度
abstract: Why does performance pressure sometimes cause choking but sometimes elicit exceptional performance? We propose that pressure shifts the complexity of information-processing rules that guide action. Performance improves when shifts move processing toward task-matched complexity and deteriorates when they promote maladaptive simplification, overcomplexification, or the use of rules that exceed available processing resources.
abstract_zh: 为什么绩效压力有时会导致失误，而有时又能激发卓越表现？我们提出，压力会改变指导行动的信息处理规则的复杂度。当压力使处理趋向与任务匹配的复杂度时，绩效会提升；当压力导致不适当的简化、过度复杂化或使用超出可用处理资源的规则时，绩效则会下降。
